title: Beehive
body:
"A buzzing way of collecting that delicious honey! Can be sawed or put in a jar!"

Description

The Beehive is an item that can be found on trees on the Finlay island.

Beehives are quite common and are not worth much.

Beehives will not be dropped if the tree is harvested before it is picked up, chopping down a tree will not bring the beehive down to allow you to harvest it.

Upon harvesting, a swarm of bees will attack the player for 15 seconds. Though not fatal, it takes up roughly 25% of the player's health.

The Beehive itself is worth roughly $1389 each beehive, once sanded, it will turn into Honeycomb, which does not change the value, then once placed into the press machine with a jar, it will be turned into Honey. You can also shove beehive to press machine, which works same as honeycomb.

This is one of woodlike material that can't be planked, as this is not a wood class.

Logged = Base Item (Beehive)

Sanded = Sanded Item (Honeycomb)

Pressed = Pressed Item (Honey)
